top_signals.title: Chip Selloff Triggers 7% Korea Rout After CEO’s ‘Casino’ Warning
top_signals.summary: A global slide in semiconductor stocks deepened, sending South Korea’s chip-heavy equity benchmark down 7% as concerns about AI overheating and Chinese competition intensified.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Smartphone Maker Transsion Raises $390 Million in HK Listing
top_signals.summary: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings Co., which dominates the market for smartphones in Africa, raised HK$3.1 billion ($390 million) from a Hong Kong share share sale after pricing the deal near the top end.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: How Red Bull's F1 team is using AI to make split-second decisions for Max Verstappen
top_signals.summary: Red Bull Racing is increasingly using AI to help make real-time Formula 1 race decisions, but the team says human judgment remains essential.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Franco-German deal on EU car policy is ‘imminent’, says Macron
top_signals.summary: Agreement would push back Europe’s phaseout of combustion engines and boost car production on the continent to combat Chinese competition
